title: Investigate an order-dependent test
prompt: A test passes alone but fails after another test modifies shared state. Explain a reproducible investigation and what repeated passing runs establish. Do not change files.
rubric: The answer varies and records order and seed, isolates shared state, and considers parallelism and environment.
It does not conclude that passing repetitions prove absence of flakiness.
It distinguishes observed results from proposed checks.
acceptance: The response satisfies the rubric, distinguishes evidence from proposals, and makes no changes.
